note: 7 Municipal District MultiPolygons aggregated from real Municipality of Athens CKAN neighbourhood polygons (neighbourhoods-athens & municipal-districts-athens, CC BY 4.0), simplified (~45 m tolerance) and clamped to the Athens bbox [23.68–23.80, 37.95–38.03] (4 northern/southern edge vertices trimmed by <=0.0027°). Main arterial roads are simplified central Athens street corridors aligned to OpenStreetMap for A1's offline map style.
